title: Console Stripped Insights: Tactical MVP Reprioritization and Acceptance Criteria
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Context: Given current resource constraints and the need to ship a usable console MVP for customers on hosted and dedicated tiers, we must surgically reduce scope across dashboards, tracing, and cost breakdowns. Goal: deliver a minimal but actionable insights surface that enables engineers and platform teams to detect regressions and quantify unit economics without blocking Dedicated/Private customers from early adoption. This ticket captures the prioritized cuts, measurable acceptance criteria, and handoffs for PM/Design/Eng. Constraints: - Keep one consolidated dashboard entry point (no multi-namespace views). - Tracing must support sampled span view only (no full-service flamegraphs). - Cost breakdown should include per-route token costs and 7-day delta only (no hourly drilldown). Trade-offs: - We sacrifice granular historical retention and deep trace drilldowns to reduce telemetry storage and engineering scope. - UX will favor clear, single-step troubleshooting flows over multi-card exploratory tooling. Risks and mitigations: - Risk: early customers ask for missing drilldowns. Mitigation: public roadmap item + migration path for add-on telemetry. - Risk: elevated false-positive alerts from coarser sampling. Mitigation: conservative default thresholds and opt-in debug tracing.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard: single 'Insights' landing card that surfaces top 3 routes by cost with 7-day change; card renders within 1.2s on first load for orgs with <= 50 routes
Dashboard: ability to filter by model and time window (24h, 7d, 30d); filter operations complete within 600ms on typical staging dataset
Tracing: sampled-span viewer that shows up to 10 spans per trace, with clear timestamped timeline and error flags; trace viewer open-to-render under 900ms for a sampled trace
Cost breakdown: per-route token cost + aggregated cost delta for 7 days available in UI and exportable as CSV; export completes under 15s for orgs <= 50 routes
Observability SLOs: page-level 95th percentile latency must be under 1.5s across the three core views (Insights, Trace, Cost) in canary environment
Fallback behavior: when telemetry query fails, UI shows cached most-recent snapshot and a clear banner explaining degraded mode; no hard errors exposed to end users
Rollout: feature flag gated rollout with ability to disable new Insights surface per org via console toggle
QA: end-to-end smoke tests covering filters, trace sampling, CSV export, and banner fallback must pass in CI
decisions: Keep Insights as a single consolidated entry point rather than separate dashboard tabs to reduce surface area and navigation logic
Limit tracing to sampled-span view only for MVP; full flamegraphs and correlational service maps deferred to post-MVP
Restrict cost breakdown to per-route and 7-day delta; hourly and per-token breakdowns beyond this scope
All heavy telemetry queries will use pre-aggregated query endpoints to reduce backend compute cost
Provide clear migration and extension doc so enterprise customers can opt into expanded telemetry post-launch
